Mechanics notes for 'Micro-Plot' (indie simulation):
- Grid layout: 2.5D isometric tiles.
- Nitrogen diffusion model: Legumes (clover, bush beans) deposit 1.5 units of bio-available nitrogen per tick into adjacent diagonal tiles.
- Pest deterrence: Marigolds reduce aphid infestation probabilities by 65% for crops planted within a 2-tile Manhattan distance.
- Water table: Clay soil retains moisture for 4 daylight cycles, sandy loam drains after 1 cycle requiring drip irrigation.
